# A&A AutoMods

> Automotive customization shop in Markham, Ontario (Toronto GTA). Star headliner, ambient LED lighting, underglow, Apple CarPlay, remote starters, dash cameras, vinyl wrap, PPF, and carbon fiber parts. By appointment only.

A&A AutoMods specializes in high-end vehicle lighting and interior upgrades. Shop address: 40 Guardsman Rd, Markham, ON L3T 6L3. Phone: (647) 677-7287. Email: aa.automods@gmail.com. Hours: Monday–Sunday 11:00–19:00. Free quotes; reply typically within 48 hours. Deposit after quote approval secures the appointment.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://aa-automods.ca/): Overview, featured projects, FAQ
- [Services](https://aa-automods.ca/services): Full service list with photos and pricing for lighting packages
- [Gallery](https://aa-automods.ca/gallery): Portfolio of completed installs
- [Contact](https://aa-automods.ca/contact): Free quote form, phone, map, PayPal deposit

## Services

- Star Headliner — fiber optic starlight headliner, custom colors and patterns
- Ambient Lighting — RGB LED with smartphone control
- Underglow — exterior LED underglow
- Service Lighting — high-visibility service vehicle lighting
- Radio — Apple CarPlay — aftermarket radio with CarPlay / Android Auto
- Remote Starter — long-range remotes and app control
- Dash Camera — HD recording, night vision, parking mode
- Vinyl Wrap — colour change, chrome delete, accents, liveries
- PPF — paint protection film (clear, satin, colour-change)
- Carbon Fiber Parts — steering wheels, trim, body components

## Service Area

Markham, Toronto, Vaughan, Richmond Hill, Scarborough, Mississauga, and the Greater Toronto Area (GTA). Work is done by appointment at the Markham shop — no walk-ins.

## Booking

1. Request a free quote via contact form, phone, or email
2. Agree on scope and price
3. Pay deposit online to lock the appointment
4. Install at 40 Guardsman Rd, Markham
